page_text_en: Stealing the Beam and Replacing the Pillar
summary_zh: 本页展示了标题“偷梁换柱”，并配有一名身穿古装、手持竹简的人物插图，暗示故事即将开始。

page_text_ocr_zh:
战国末年的时候，秦王嬴政先后吞并了韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐六个诸侯国。
天下都是秦国的了！嬴政很骄傲，认为自己的功劳比传说中的三皇五帝还要大，便给自己起了一个新的尊号——始皇帝。公元前221年，嬴政身穿黑色的帝王服，头戴冠冕，登上了皇帝的宝座。
page_text_en:
At the end of the Warring States period, King Ying Zheng of Qin successively annexed the six feudal states: Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan, and Qi.
All under heaven belonged to Qin! Ying Zheng was very proud, believing his achievements surpassed even those of the legendary Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, so he gave himself a new title—the First Emperor. In 221 BC, Ying Zheng wore black imperial robes, donned a crown, and ascended the throne of emperor.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了秦王嬴政在吞并六国后，于公元前221年自封为始皇帝，并登基称帝的历史事件。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他向文武大臣们宣告："从古到今，我就是第一个皇帝。这天下，要世世代代传给我的子孙。我是始皇帝，我的儿子是二世，孙子是三世……一直传到万世！" 从此以后，嬴政就成为一统天下的始皇帝——秦始皇。
page_text_en: He announced to the civil and military officials: "From ancient times to the present, I am the first emperor. This realm shall be passed down from generation to generation to my descendants. I am the First Emperor, my son will be the Second, my grandson the Third... all the way to the ten thousandth generation!" From then on, Ying Zheng became the First Emperor who unified the realm—the Qin Shi Huang.
summary_zh: 秦始皇向文武大臣宣告自己为始皇帝，并宣布皇位将世世代代传给子孙，直至万世，从此正式成为一统天下的秦始皇。

page_text_ocr_zh: 秦始皇有二十多个儿子，他最看重的是大儿子扶苏，因为他善良又勇敢。有一次，秦始皇命人烧了许多以前诸侯国的诗书，还抓了四百六十多个说他坏话的儒生、招摇撞骗的方士。扶苏劝他说：‘父亲，现在天下刚刚安定，您抓这么多人，臣民心里都很害怕，会发生动乱的！’
page_text_en: Qin Shi Huang had more than twenty sons, and he valued his eldest son Fu Su the most, because he was kind and brave. Once, Qin Shi Huang ordered the burning of many poems and books from the former feudal states, and also arrested more than four hundred and sixty scholars who spoke ill of him and fraudulent alchemists. Fu Su advised him: 'Father, the world has just been stabilized. Arresting so many people will make the subjects fearful and may cause unrest!'
summary_zh: 本页讲述了秦始皇焚书坑儒事件，以及其长子扶苏对此表示担忧并劝谏父亲，担心此举会引发动乱。

page_text_ocr_zh: 秦始皇听了，生气地说："哼，你是我的儿子，竟然敢说我做得不对，还这么软弱心善，以后怎么治理国家！去，到北疆修长城，打匈奴，跟蒙将军学学吧！"他把扶苏派到大将蒙恬身边，做了监军。
page_text_en: The First Emperor of Qin, upon hearing this, angrily said: "Hmph, you are my son, yet you dare say I am wrong, and you are so weak and kind-hearted. How will you govern the country in the future! Go, to the northern frontier to build the Great Wall, fight the Xiongnu, and learn from General Meng!" He sent Fu Su to General Meng Tian's side to serve as a supervisor.
summary_zh: 秦始皇因长子扶苏劝谏焚书坑儒而大怒，斥责其软弱无能，并将其派往北疆修长城、抗击匈奴，担任蒙恬的监军。

page_text_ocr_zh: 秦始皇最喜欢的是活泼调皮的小儿子胡亥。有一次，秦始皇设宴招待群臣。大臣们的鞋子，都按照官职大小，整整齐齐地摆放在门口。守门的侍卫肚子疼，跑出去上了趟厕所，回来就发现：门口的鞋子东一只西一只，有的还跑到了台阶下面！如果被秦始皇知道了，小侍卫可就遭殃了，这可怎么办呀？
page_text_en: Qin Shi Huang's favorite son was the lively and mischievous Hu Hai. One time, Qin Shi Huang held a banquet to entertain his ministers. The ministers' shoes were arranged neatly at the entrance according to their ranks. The gatekeeper, suffering from stomach pain, ran out to use the restroom. When he returned, he found: the shoes at the entrance were scattered—some here, some there, and some even ended up under the steps! If Qin Shi Huang found out, the young gatekeeper would be in big trouble. What should he do?
summary_zh: 本页讲述了秦始皇设宴时，守门侍卫因肚子疼离开岗位，导致大臣们的鞋子被胡亥偷偷挪动，侍卫担心被责罚而惊慌失措的情景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
侍卫吓得跪倒在地上，忽然听到远处有笑声传来，"哈哈哈，太好玩了！"
他抬头一看，只见胡亥正踢着大臣们的鞋子玩。也只有胡亥有这么大的胆子，敢在皇帝的宴会上胡闹，侍卫这才放下心来。秦始皇知道胡亥的恶作剧后，只是笑着拍了拍他的头，并没有处罚他。
page_text_en:
The guard fell to his knees in fear, but then heard laughter coming from afar, "Hahaha, this is so much fun!"
He looked up and saw Huhai kicking the ministers' shoes around. Only Huhai had the guts to cause such a ruckus at the emperor's banquet, so the guard finally relaxed. When Emperor Qin Shi Huang found out about Huhai's prank, he simply laughed and patted him on the head, without punishing him.
summary_zh: 侍卫因离开岗位而惊慌，发现是胡亥在宴会上踢大臣的鞋子取乐，秦始皇得知后并未处罚胡亥，反而笑着拍了拍他的头。

page_text_ocr_zh:
秦始皇这两个儿子，哪一个能做太子，继承秦朝的皇位呢？
有的大臣说，扶苏是长子，又很能干，一定能做个好太子；有的
大臣说，胡亥最受宠爱，皇帝肯定会立他做太子。
秦始皇是怎么想的呢？
page_text_en:
Which of Emperor Qin Shi Huang's two sons could become the crown prince and inherit the throne of the Qin dynasty?
Some ministers said, 'Fusu is the eldest son and very capable; he is sure to be a good crown prince.' Others said, 'Hu Hai is the most beloved by the emperor; the emperor will surely make him the crown prince.'
What was Emperor Qin Shi Huang thinking?
summary_zh: 本页描绘了秦始皇在朝堂上思考立太子的问题，大臣们分别支持长子扶苏和受宠的次子胡亥，画面中秦始皇沉思，大臣们纷纷进言。

page_text_ocr_zh:
"等我寻到神仙，吃了长生不老药，就可以永远做皇帝，根本不需要立太子！"
秦始皇为了视察军政民情，显示威仪，也为了寻仙问道，长生不老，经常巡游天下。
page_text_en:
"Once I find the immortals and eat the elixir of eternal life, I can be emperor forever, and there's no need to crown a crown prince!"
Qin Shi Huang, in order to inspect military, political, and civilian affairs, display his majesty, and also to seek immortals and achieve eternal life, often toured the empire.
summary_zh: 秦始皇宣称寻得长生不老药后可永做皇帝，因此无需立太子，并因寻仙问道、视察民情而经常巡游天下。

page_text_ocr_zh:
巡游时，秦始皇每天不仅要赶路，还要批阅快马送来的奏章，听文武百官的汇报。只过了半年，他就生了重病，连吃药的力气也没有了。

在秦始皇准备第六次巡游时，小儿子胡亥跪坐在他身边，拉着他的胳膊哀求说："父亲，我已经二十岁了，还从来没有出过咸阳城呢！您就带着我一起去出去玩一玩吧！"秦始皇笑着答应了。
page_text_en:
During his tours, Emperor Qin Shi Huang had to travel long distances every day, as well as review urgent memorials delivered by fast horses and listen to reports from civil and military officials. After only half a year, he fell seriously ill and even lost the strength to take his medicine.

When Emperor Qin Shi Huang was preparing for his sixth tour, his youngest son Huai knelt beside him, holding his arm and pleading: "Father, I am already twenty years old, and I have never left Xianyang! Please take me along to go out and play for a while!" Emperor Qin Shi Huang smiled and agreed.
summary_zh: 本页描述秦始皇因频繁巡游而积劳成疾，身体日渐衰弱；在准备第六次巡游时，小儿子胡亥请求随行，秦始皇笑着答应了。

page_text_ocr_zh: "快叫丞相李斯！"秦始皇知道自己快要死了，他吃力地说出了给大儿子扶苏的遗诏：把大军交给蒙恬，快马加鞭赶回咸阳，为我举行葬礼吧！谁为皇帝举行葬礼，谁就能做新皇帝。秦始皇这是要把皇位传给扶苏呀！
page_text_en: "Quick, call Chancellor Li Si!" Emperor Qin Shi Huang knew he was about to die. With great effort, he spoke his last will to his eldest son, Fu Su: "Hand over the army to Meng Tian. Ride back to Xianyang as fast as you can and hold my funeral! Whoever holds the emperor's funeral will become the new emperor." Emperor Qin Shi Huang was about to pass the throne to Fu Su!
summary_zh: 秦始皇病重垂危，临终前口述遗诏，命长子扶苏接掌皇位，并指示其与蒙恬率军回咸阳主持葬礼，明确传位意图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
宦官赵高将秦始皇的遗诏写下来，盖上了玉玺。可是，还没来得及叫使者送出去，秦始皇就闭上了眼睛。
"父亲！父亲！"胡亥吓得大哭起来。李斯急忙上前，一把捂住了他的嘴，小声说："公子，如果始皇帝去世的消息传出去，天下会大乱的！我们得保守住这个秘密呀！"
page_text_en:
Eunuch Zhao Gao wrote down Emperor Qin Shi Huang's will and sealed it with the imperial jade seal. But before he could send a messenger to deliver it, Emperor Qin Shi Huang closed his eyes.
"Father! Father!" Hu Hai cried out in terror. Li Si rushed forward, covering his mouth and whispering, "Prince, if the news of the Emperor's death spreads, the realm will fall into chaos! We must keep this secret!"
summary_zh: 秦始皇病逝前口述遗诏，命长子扶苏继位，但遗诏尚未送出，秦始皇便去世。胡亥惊哭，李斯急忙捂住其嘴，劝其保守皇帝驾崩的秘密，以防天下大乱。

page_text_ocr_zh: 为了防止消息泄露，秦始皇的遗体被李斯安放在四面都有帷帐的车里。快马送来的奏章，李斯在车里代秦始皇批阅；百官来拜见，宦官像往常一样代秦始皇回答；每天的饭食，都准时送到车里，也是宦官代秦始皇吃完。一切都跟秦始皇活着的时候一样。
page_text_en: To prevent the news from leaking, Emperor Qin Shi Huang's body was placed by Li Si in a carriage with curtains on all four sides. Documents delivered by fast horses were reviewed and approved by Li Si inside the carriage; when officials came to pay respects, eunuchs answered on behalf of the emperor as usual; daily meals were delivered on time to the carriage and eaten by eunuchs on the emperor's behalf. Everything was carried out just as it had been when Emperor Qin Shi Huang was still alive.
summary_zh: 秦始皇驾崩后，李斯与宦官将遗体藏于帷帐车中，对外隐瞒死讯，由李斯代批奏章、宦官代为应答和进食，维持一切如常，以稳定朝局。

page_text_ocr_zh: 但是，秦始皇给扶苏的遗诏，却一直被扣留在赵高的手中。他捏着遗诏，与丞相李斯商量说：‘如果扶苏做了皇帝，他最信任的人是蒙恬，我们什么好处也占不上。那还不如让胡亥做皇帝呢！’ 于是，他们烧毁了秦始皇的遗诏，伪造了一份诏书，立胡亥为太子。
page_text_en: But the will that Emperor Qin Shi Huang left for Fu Su was kept in Zhao Gao's hands. Holding the will, he discussed with Chancellor Li Si: 'If Fu Su becomes emperor, the person he trusts most is Meng Tian. We won't gain anything. It would be better to make Hu Hai the emperor!' So, they burned Emperor Qin Shi Huang's will, forged a new edict, and declared Hu Hai as the crown prince.
summary_zh: 赵高与李斯密谋，扣留秦始皇传位给扶苏的遗诏，烧毁原诏，伪造新诏立胡亥为太子。

page_text_ocr_zh: 然后，赵高给扶苏和蒙恬写了一封信：扶苏、蒙恬，带领三十万军队驻守边疆，十几年来，士兵伤亡无数，却没有立下半点战功。扶苏不孝顺父亲，赐剑！蒙恬不知道规劝，赐死！赵高封好信，盖上秦始皇的玉玺，就派人送到了北疆。
page_text_en: Then, Zhao Gao wrote a letter to Fu Su and Meng Tian: 'Fu Su, Meng Tian, you have led thirty thousand troops to guard the frontier for years. In the past decade, countless soldiers have been killed or wounded, yet you have achieved no military merit. Fu Su, you are disobedient to your father, be executed by sword! Meng Tian, you failed to advise, be executed! Zhao Gao sealed the letter, stamped it with the imperial jade seal, and sent it to the northern frontier.
summary_zh: 赵高伪造秦始皇遗诏，诬陷扶苏和蒙恬不忠不孝，下令赐死，并派人将假诏送往北疆。

page_text_ocr_zh: 胡亥跟着赵高和李斯，带着秦始皇的遗体回到咸阳城，马上公布了秦始皇病故的消息。赵高拿出假诏书，让胡亥继承了皇位，成为秦朝的第二任皇帝。赵高用了“偷梁换柱”的计策，没费一兵一卒，就让胡亥做了皇帝。
page_text_en: Huhai, accompanied by Zhao Gao and Li Si, brought Qin Shi Huang's body back to Xianyang and immediately announced the emperor's death. Zhao Gao presented a forged edict, allowing Huhai to inherit the throne and become the second emperor of the Qin dynasty. Zhao Gao used the scheme of 'substituting the beam for the pillar,' without spending a single soldier, he made Huhai the emperor.
summary_zh: 胡亥在赵高和李斯的协助下，将秦始皇遗体带回咸阳，公布其死讯，并通过赵高伪造的诏书继承皇位，赵高以“偷梁换柱”之计，使胡亥顺利登基。
